overview.title: Income and expenses
overview.description: What the cooperative took in, what it paid out, and what is left.
overview.loadFailed: We could not load these figures. Check your connection and try again.
overview.headlineLabel: These three figures cover the whole period chosen below.

range.title: Period
range.description: Every figure on this screen covers these dates.

groupBy.label: Grouped by
groupBy.hint: How much time each pair of bars covers.

headline.balanceHint: Including {{opening}} carried in from before this period.

movement.title: Movement over the period
movement.description: One pair of bars for each period: what came in, and what went out.
movement.empty: Nothing was recorded in this period.
movement.tableCaption: The same figures, period by period.

breakdown.descriptionIn: Money in, category by category, largest first.
breakdown.descriptionOut: Money out, category by category, largest first.
breakdown.emptyIn: No money came in during this period.
breakdown.emptyOut: No money went out during this period.

recent.title: The last few entries
recent.description: The five most recent entries of the chosen period.
recent.caption: The most recent entries of the chosen period, with the date, what the money was for and the amount.
recent.emptyBody: Choose a wider period, or record the first entry from the ledger.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Every movement of money the cooperative has recorded, newest first.
ledger.caption: Entries in the cooperative's books, with the reference, the date, the category, the amount and how the money moved.
ledger.exportFailed: We could not produce the file. Check your connection and try again.
ledger.loadFailed: We could not load the ledger. Check your connection and try again.
ledger.totalsCover: These three cover every page of the current filters.
ledger.emptyBody: Record the first movement of money, in or out, and it appears here with its reference.
ledger.emptyFilteredBody: Widen the dates or the amounts, or clear the filters to see the whole ledger.

search.label: Search the ledger
search.placeholder: Reference, or what the money was for

source.PAYMENT: From a payment to a member

entry.cancelAtSource: Cancel this from the member's record
entry.editTitle: Change the category or the note
entry.editFixed: The amount, the direction and the date of a recorded entry can never be changed. A wrong figure is cancelled instead, which writes a correction and leaves both entries in the books.

void.title: Cancel this entry?
void.consequence: The entry stays in the books, and a matching correction of the opposite kind is written beside it, so the balance returns to what it was. Nothing is deleted.
void.reasonHint: One line, for example: recorded twice by mistake.
void.reasonRequired: Say why this entry is being cancelled.

entryDialog.descriptionIn: Money the cooperative has received. It is added to the balance as soon as it is recorded.
entryDialog.descriptionOut: Money the cooperative has paid out. It is taken off the balance as soon as it is recorded.
entryDialog.noCategoriesIn: No income category has been set up yet, so money coming in cannot be recorded. Add one on the categories screen first.
entryDialog.noCategoriesOut: No expense category has been set up yet, so money going out cannot be recorded. Add one on the categories screen first.
entryDialog.restateIn: This records {{amount}} received by the cooperative.
entryDialog.restateOut: This records {{amount}} paid out by the cooperative.

entryFields.amountHint: Whole francs, for example 5000. Two decimal places at most.
entryFields.occurredAtHint: Today, unless the money moved on another day.
entryFields.descriptionHint: One line the office will still understand next year, for example: receipt 04521, transport to Kigali.
entryFields.memberHint: Leave empty unless the money was paid to, or received from, one member. Naming them puts it on their profile.
entryFields.memberPlaceholder: Search by name, member code or phone number
entryFields.memberClear: Remove the member from this entry

entryErrors.amount: Write an amount greater than zero, using digits only, with at most two decimal places.
entryErrors.occurredAt: Write the date as a real date.
entryErrors.categoryId: Choose the category this money belongs to.
entryErrors.description: Say what the money was for.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: What the cooperative's money is recorded against. A category is never deleted, only put out of service.
categories.loadFailed: We could not load the categories. Check your connection and try again.
categories.showInactiveHint: A category out of service takes no new entries, and keeps the ones already recorded against it.
categories.descriptionIn: What money the cooperative receives is recorded against.
categories.descriptionOut: What money the cooperative pays out is recorded against.
categories.captionIn: Income categories, with their Kinyarwanda name, code, how many entries use them and their total.
categories.captionOut: Expense categories, with their Kinyarwanda name, code, how many entries use them and their total.
categories.emptyBody: Money cannot be recorded until there is a category to record it against.
categories.deactivateInUse: {{entries}} entries are already recorded against it. They keep it as their category and not one of them changes. It simply stops being offered when new money is recorded.
categories.deactivateUnused: Nothing is recorded against it yet. It stops being offered when new money is recorded, and it can be put back in service at any time.
categories.deactivateConfirm: Yes, put it out of service
categories.restoreConsequence: It is offered again when new money is recorded.

categoryDialog.descriptionIn: A category for money the cooperative receives.
categoryDialog.descriptionOut: A category for money the cooperative pays out.
categoryDialog.kindFixedIn: This is an income category and it stays one. A category's kind can never change: moving it would flip the side of the balance every entry already recorded against it falls on.
categoryDialog.kindFixedOut: This is an expense category and it stays one. A category's kind can never change: moving it would flip the side of the balance every entry already recorded against it falls on.
categoryDialog.systemOrigin: This category came with the system. It can be renamed and it can be put out of service, and like every category it is never deleted.

categoryFields.name: Name
categoryFields.nameRwHint: Shown to anybody reading the system in Kinyarwanda. Leave it empty to use the name above.
categoryFields.codeHint: For a cooperative that already numbers its categories on paper.

categoryErrors.name: A name is needed.
categoryErrors.nameRw: That Kinyarwanda name is too long.
categoryErrors.code: A code is twenty characters at most.

apiErrors.alreadyVoid: That entry has already been cancelled.
apiErrors.voidFromSource: This entry came from a member's record. Cancel it from that member's contributions or shares, so the books and the member's own history stay in step.
apiErrors.voidedNotEditable: A cancelled entry cannot be changed. It stays as it is, beside its correction.
apiErrors.categoryNameTaken: A category with that name already exists on this side of the books.
